column3: sealed_stone|built|Ancient carved stone blocks of the same lost star-born people who laid the blue-grey ley stone, here in a warm copper-brown stone (#3e2e26 #5a4234 #78573f #93704f #ad8a64): large dressed blocks in two staggered courses with fine bevelled joints a deep shade of the stone, weathered smooth edges, a faint thin inlaid groove of dull green copper patina (#5f8a76) running along each course like a channel, one block carved with a small seal mark (a circle crossed by a short bar)
column4: warded_stone|built|The same ancient carved stone blocks of the star-born people, in a deep cobalt-blue stone (#232c44 #33405e #4a5a7e #627399 #7d8db0): large dressed blocks in two staggered courses with fine bevelled joints a deep shade of the stone, weathered smooth edges, a thin inlaid groove of pale silver-blue (#9cc4e0) running along each course with a faint cold glow, one block carved with a small ward rune (a diamond with a dot in it)
column5: ruin_pedestal_side|face|The side of an ancient lectern pedestal of cool blue-grey ley stone (#3e4650 #586270 #76828e #919ca6 #aab4bc), filling the square: a wider bevelled base course at the bottom, a wider overhanging lip at the top, and between them a recessed arched niche carved with one angular rune of the star-born ancients (a circle crossed by four short lines), its grooves inlaid with pale blue-silver (#8fb4c8) holding a faint cold glow (#7fb0d8), weathered edges
column6: ruin_pedestal_top|framed|The top of the ancient lectern pedestal: one square slab of the same cool blue-grey ley stone (#3e4650 #586270 #76828e #919ca6 #aab4bc) with a bevelled rim, in its middle a shallow rectangular reading recess framed by a thin inlay of pale blue-silver (#8fb4c8) with a faint cold glow, a small four-pointed star carved in each corner of the slab, weathered
